top_stories.title: Evacuation of Ukrainians from Occupied Territories
top_stories.summary: Multiple groups of residents from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky have successfully arrived in Ukraine following a humanitarian evacuation operation. The newly arrived citizens experienced emotional reunions with their families after years spent trapped in the frontline territory.

top_stories.title: Widespread Demonstrations in France
top_stories.summary: The French interior ministry reported that approximately 320,000 people took to the streets nationwide for the third consecutive week of demonstrations. The government deployed robust security measures while authorities braced for potential disorder and clashes after dark.

top_stories.title: Judicial Power Struggle in Poland
top_stories.summary: Poland's political landscape faced severe strain as the president pushed his way into the top court during an ongoing rule-of-law dispute. This action resulted in a direct physical confrontation with judges amid a deepening institutional crisis.
